intro.text: A bridgeman in Bridge Four who was killed in the Battle of the Tower.

items.text: On Kaladin's first bridge run as leader of Bridge Four, Malop was one of the last men to get into position.
In the Battle of the Tower, Malop took a bad axe wound to the arm from the Parshendi and bled to death. Kaladin regretted that he couldn't save him, Jaks or Narm.
Malop was among those Kaladin remembered failing to protect when he tried to speak the Fourth Ideal.

appearance.text: Thick black hair and a bushy beard, with a glyphward tattooed on each hand.

personality.text: Not thought very clever, and knows little of the world beyond Alethkar.
